meta.name: knowledge-consolidation
meta.description: Distills the Knowledge Capture log into a clean, actionable reference of tribal knowledge and prior pitfalls. Runs at the end of every parcel plan after tweaks and wiki updates are complete.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼零散经验和坑点,做成团队随手可查的参考
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次项目收尾都要花大量时间把零散经验整理成团队能用的参考资料
copy.tagline_en: Distill scattered knowledge and pitfalls into a practical team reference.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spend hours consolidating scattered team knowledge after each project.

howto.what: Claude 会整理项目的知识捕获日志：读取日志和刚完成的计划，提炼其中的坑和规则，合并重复条目、删去过时内容、精简冗长条目，最后按统一格式重写成简洁可操作的参考，并汇报改动统计。
howto.when: 当 parcel plan 完成并准备归档时触发，作为最后一步；或用户明确要求整理知识日志（如说“consolidate knowledge”等）；或 pre-deployment-vibe-auditor 发现日志臃肿或矛盾时触发。

say.text: 合并知识捕获日志里的重复条目。
say.note: Claude 会执行合并并报告改动。

say.text: 整理最近完成计划的知识经验。
say.note: 它会从计划中提炼新陷阱和规则。

say.text: 清理知识日志，删去过时内容。
say.note: 它会向你确认后才删除。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews the project's knowledge-capture log and the just-finished plan, distills pitfalls and rules, merges duplicates, cuts obsolete entries, tightens verbose ones, rewrites the log as a concise actionable reference, and reports the change stats.
howto.when_en: On parcel-plan completion before archiving; when the user explicitly requests consolidation (e.g. "consolidate knowledge"); or when pre-deployment-vibe-auditor flags the log as bloated/contradictory.

say_en.text: Merge duplicate entries in the knowledge-capture log.
say_en.note: Claude will merge and report changes.

say_en.text: Consolidate knowledge from the latest completed plan.
say_en.note: It will distill new pitfalls and rules.

say_en.text: Tidy the knowledge log and cut obsolete items.
say_en.note: It will ask for confirmation before deleting.
